title: Use C99 instead of GLib types in doc+docbook
description:
Ran `tools/convert-glib-types.py` over the files in `doc/` and
`docbook/`, then manually checked/massaged/reverted results as
appropriate.

One small step towards addressing #19116

notes.body:
added 7 commits
  • f091ba97...47b310da - 6 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 5789bc79 - Use C99 instead of GLib types in doc+docbook
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/12952/diffs?diff_id=831939486&start_sha=f091ba9735c87bb0337f1b424419bdb539dad630)
